thesis: SOP Lang proposes operational, semantic and epistemic interfaces that organize shared search, revision and auditable answers; finite models illustrate mechanisms without validating the full architecture.
role: Chapters 19–23 integrate the design, a worked question and carefully bounded observations.

ideas.statement: Interfaces expose content kind, guarantee and dependencies through shared references; operational validity cannot launder uncertain premises into certainty.
The expander joins forward possibilities and backward requirements in a shared graph, filtering cheaply and checking acceptance more strongly.
The key example illustrates question-relative ambiguity, abstention and local retraction when a transfer is corrected to showing.
Parameter learning, circuit learning and representation learning differ; reusable abstractions must transfer and their library, exception and human costs remain visible.
Short justification, diagnostic alternatives and reproducible computation serve distinct audit needs; value provenance differs from search-decision provenance.
Finite affine models demonstrate exact merging with supplied coefficients, not learned representations; counts concern extensions rather than measured full speedups.
Parity constraint experiments show the inadequacy of individual domains and value of suitable relational algebra, without disproving all local propagation.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: At sixteen stages, 65 536 histories corresponded to 430 final functions and 4 794 forward extensions; modulus and representation were supplied.
The key example must not invent who returned the key from a later observation.
A corrected transfer should invalidate only dependent conclusions while preserving independent information.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The worked language example is proposed behavior, not prototype achievement.
Finite results leave economical autonomous interface discovery and language transfer unproven.
Formal verification of a plan does not authorize its external effects.

audit.notes: Read every unit; preserve proposed versus demonstrated status.
